title: Audio Ecosystem, API, License & Authority Survey
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-26 America/Chicago after fresh verification of AIOC main e0fbf5259a59c5ee70f87f86c241092b6da0b7db and application main da9314298c104723ff3b04e12b1df1e264d55300, re-reading the AAI program/backlog and MAI-10 closeout and freshly surveying current provider/API/terms/license/entitlement evidence before resolving this bounded survey-only contract.
objective: Implement AAI-01 as a static provider-neutral audio ecosystem/API/license/authority evidence survey. Record what current sources actually document, including unsupported and unknown capabilities, without authenticating to providers, acquiring provider content, copying commercial audio or implementing playback/adapters/schema mechanics.

local_user_owned.authority: User-selected local files/folders may be catalogued only with user-supplied source/provenance/license evidence; file possession alone does not establish redistribution, public-performance or commercial rights.
local_user_owned.format_rule: Survey common candidate families such as WAV/PCM, MP3, AAC/M4A, Ogg/Vorbis or Opus and FLAC, but do not claim universal support. Future playback/import must runtime-probe platform codec/container capability through web/native capability seams.

syrinscape.documented: Public HTTP search/content/session controls plus iframe and JavaScript/Web Audio embedding with auth-token/session identity are documented.
syrinscape.boundary: Record capability only. Do not obtain/store live auth tokens, enumerate a user's commercial library, acquire audio or make provider calls in AAI-01.

tabletone.documented: Current app/account/content-pack workflows are documented; own-sound import is currently unavailable and browser/server client-host integration is described as planned.
tabletone.public_developer_api: No public developer API/SDK documentation was located in the surveyed official sources; this is an evidence state, not a claim that no private/partner interface exists.
tabletone.boundary: Treat direct programmatic integration as not-publicly-documented/provider-contact-required; no scraping or reverse-engineered workaround.

pocket_bard.documented: Current mobile/desktop app provides adaptive music, ambiences and one-shots. Terms last updated 2026-08-14 grant bounded TTRPG use and prohibit ripping/redistribution, automated scraping and reverse engineering.
pocket_bard.public_developer_api: No public developer API/SDK documentation was located in the surveyed official sources.
pocket_bard.boundary: Treat future integration as external-app/manual-reference or provider-contact-required unless current public/partner capability is later verified.

tabletop_audio.documented: Browser SoundPads provide layered audio and an official local Stream Deck companion exposes local control URLs. Ten-minute ambiences are CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; SoundPad sounds are expressly not meant to be downloaded or used outside tabletopaudio.com.
tabletop_audio.boundary: Future use may reference browser/local-control capability but must not download, rehost or treat SoundPad audio as ingestible content absent separate permission.

resolved_contract.provider_neutral_rule: Provider identity, provider content identity and semantic audio intent remain separate. No provider/catalog is canonical and no provider is assumed complete.
resolved_contract.fail_closed: Unsupported, unavailable, planned-not-current, not-publicly-documented, unknown-unverified, entitlement-denied or license-restricted capability remains explicit and cannot be promoted to supported by inference or workaround.
resolved_contract.owner_rule: Audio is presentation/support state only. Survey metadata, cue names, soundscape structure or provider state cannot create or replace canonical World, Event, Scene, Combat, Action or other gameplay truth.
resolved_contract.content_rule: Commercial provider audio remains controlled/referenced through legitimate provider/user entitlement unless explicit license evidence permits local ingestion. AAI-01 itself does not ingest provider audio.

persistence.result: No runtime audio/provider ledger or durable schema delta is required for this survey; repository evidence files are sufficient.

validation_contract.focused: Verify current-survey evidence classes, capability-state vocabulary, provider-neutrality, fail-closed unsupported/unknown behavior, local-file provenance boundary, content/license restrictions, audio-intent separation and gameplay-owner nonauthority.
validation_contract.predecessors: Preserve MAI-10 completed proof and MIB-11/D18 World-owner regression; no completed MAI evidence may be reopened or weakened.
validation_contract.workflow: Wire AAI-01 into canonical Repository Health and self-hosted Validation Core profile discovery without creating a provider network dependency.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows AAI-01 Validation Core, deterministic cross-platform comparison and declared predecessor/owner regressions before merge.

preserved_boundaries: MAI-01..10 remain completed_verified with no further MAI implementation authority
AAI-01 is completed_verified with no further implementation authority
audio intent remains separate from selected provider asset/reference
no provider/catalog is canonical and unsupported capability remains explicit
user-owned file possession does not infer redistribution/public-performance/commercial rights
commercial provider audio is controlled/referenced rather than copied absent explicit license
Pocket Bard scraping/reverse engineering prohibitions and Tabletop Audio SoundPad outside-site restrictions remain binding evidence
no provider acquisition/download/authentication/scraping/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation
AAI-02 remains selection-only until a future governed start
next_action: Closed. AAI-01 is completed_verified with no further implementation authority. AAI-02 is selected_not_started only and requires a future governed start before implementation.
